facts.text: Serve dessert when Andy packs up for college and the toys go in the box.
facts.why: Andy puts most of the toys in a bag for the attic and takes only Woody in the college box. The toys go in a donation box to Bonnie only at the end.
facts.fix: Serve dessert when Andy packs the toys into a box for Bonnie.
